items.title: Salvadoran migrant self-deports to Spain after legal battle
items.feedTitle: Van Hollen: Abrego Garcia leaving US, 'will be safe' amid self-deportation reports
items.summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, whose wrongful deportation and subsequent return became a focal point in Trump administration immigration disputes, has voluntarily left the United States for Spain. The case drew significant attention from lawmakers and civil rights advocates who questioned the legality of his initial deportation and celebrated his safe departure as a free man.

items.title: Army proceeds with Iowa lead azide detonation amid resident concerns
items.feedTitle: Lead azide must be detonated in Iowa, Army says; some residents urged to evacuate
items.summary: The U.S. Army is moving forward with plans to detonate lead azide munitions in rural Iowa on Wednesday despite unresolved concerns from nearby residents about potential toxic lead dust exposure. The Army says precautions are in place and there is no reason to panic, though conflicting information about how far the plume could travel has caused controversy.

items.title: Trump awards Presidential Medal of Freedom to Rudy Giuliani
items.feedTitle: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Presidential Medal of Freedom
items.summary: President Trump awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Rudy Giuliani, his former personal lawyer and New York City mayor who played a central role in efforts to overturn the 2020 election. Giuliani accepted the honor, saying he was 'very, very humbled' by the recognition.

items.title: Nor'easter brings Thanksgiving travel disruptions to East Coast
items.feedTitle: Nor'easter to bring Thanksgiving weather misery to millions
items.summary: A major nor'easter storm is forecast to strike the eastern United States ahead of Thanksgiving, threatening to disrupt holiday travel with heavy rain, strong winds, and potential flooding. The timing coincides with one of the busiest travel periods of the year.

items.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei convicted of trade secret theft
items.feedTitle: US court convicts China’s Huawei for fraud, conspiring to steal trade secrets, in sprawling trial over Iran business
items.summary: A U.S. federal jury found Huawei guilty of fraud and conspiracy to steal trade secrets in a months-long trial in New York, though the company was acquitted of the most serious charge of criminal racketeering. The conviction follows allegations that Huawei conducted illegal business in Iran-sanctioned countries and made false statements to U.S. officials.

stlouis.title: Missouri Supreme Court disbarred former Circuit Attorney Kim Gardner
stlouis.feedTitle: UPDATE: Former St. Louis Circuit Attorney Gardner disbarred by Missouri Supreme Court
stlouis.summary: The Missouri Supreme Court has disbarred former St. Louis Circuit Attorney Kim Gardner in an ethics case related to her prosecution of former Governor Eric Greitens. The disbarment is a rare and significant sanction, marking a major professional consequence for the controversial prosecutor.

stlouis.title: Winter storm threatens St. Louis Thanksgiving travel plans
stlouis.feedTitle: First winter weather threat in 265 days targets St. Louis as Thanksgiving travel ramps up
stlouis.summary: A winter storm watch is in effect for the St. Louis region ahead of Thanksgiving, with forecasters predicting up to 6 inches of snow and winds near 40 mph. The first significant winter weather in 265 days is expected to impact holiday travel across Missouri and Illinois.

stlouis.title: Iowa lead azide detonation poses potential regional air quality risk
stlouis.feedTitle: Will the Iowa detonations affect St. Louis?
stlouis.summary: The U.S. Army's planned detonation of lead azide munitions in Iowa has raised questions about whether toxic lead dust could reach St. Louis and surrounding areas. Officials are assessing the potential regional impact of the controlled explosion scheduled for Wednesday.

items.title: U.S. Army set to detonate toxic lead munitions in rural Iowa
items.feedTitle: US army to detonate 68 barrels of toxic lead in Iowa on day before Thanksgiving
items.summary: The U.S. Army is proceeding with plans to detonate 68 barrels (five tons) of lead azide at an ammunition plant in Iowa on Wednesday morning, despite delays and conflicting information about the potential spread of toxic lead dust. Residents have been warned to stay indoors as the detonation moves forward after repeated scheduling changes.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis encircle temporary capital; residents plan mass evacuation
items.feedTitle: ‘They don’t believe in freedom’: Yemenis plan their escape as Houthis advance on Aden
items.summary: With Iranian-backed Houthi fighters advancing on the port city of Aden, Yemen's temporary capital, residents and humanitarian organizations are preparing to evacuate. The encirclement threatens the Saudi-backed Yemeni government's stronghold and raises concerns about regional stability.

items.title: China investigates Shanghai party chief in latest Xi purge
items.feedTitle: China investigates politburo star in Xi Jinping’s latest purge
items.summary: China has launched a corruption investigation into Chen Jining, Shanghai's Communist Party chief and a member of the elite Politburo who was regarded as a potential contender for higher office. This marks the fourth Politburo member investigated since 2025, continuing Xi Jinping's consolidation of power.

items.title: China-linked network uses AI deepfakes to smear Taiwan election candidates
items.feedTitle: China-linked network using AI fakes to smear Taiwan election candidates, BBC Verify finds
items.summary: A China-linked network has deployed artificial intelligence-generated fake personas to attack key figures in Taiwan's ruling Democratic Progressive Party ahead of elections, including President Lai Ching-te. The coordinated campaign marks a notable escalation in AI-enabled disinformation targeting democratic processes.

items.title: Russia's death toll in Ukraine reaches nearly 500,000, leaked data shows
items.feedTitle: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine
items.summary: Leaked Russian data reveals that the country has suffered almost 500,000 military deaths in the Ukraine war, fundamentally altering Russia's mortality patterns. The figures, kept secret by Vladimir Putin's government, show casualty rates at one point reaching 720 per day.

items.title: Two Indians injured in Houthi attack on Riyadh financial tower
items.feedTitle: At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Saudi capital
items.summary: At least two Indian nationals were among eleven people injured when Houthi militia attacked a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District in a strike described by Saudi Civil Defence as a 'terrorist attack.' India has condemned the incident and called for regional stability.

items.title: Rising food prices squeeze Indian household budgets amid inflation
items.feedTitle: Inflation: How rising food prices are squeezing Indian households
items.summary: India faces broadening food inflation that is squeezing household budgets across the country. The cost of a traditional thali meal has jumped 16% in less than ten months, with vegetables like onions and garlic seeing particularly steep price increases.

items.title: Asia Power Index 2026: India ranked third globally, Modi second most effective
items.feedTitle: Asia Power Index 2026: US takes the lead, India listed at No. 3
items.summary: India has been ranked the third-largest Asian power globally in the latest Asia Power Index 2026, with Prime Minister Modi identified as the second most effective leader in the region. The rankings reflect India's growing strategic importance in the global order.

items.title: Nepal PM's Delhi visit signals shift in India-Nepal bilateral relations
items.feedTitle: Balen Shah once raked up India-Nepal border row. What changed on his Delhi visit?
items.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister Balen Shah, who previously raised India-Nepal border disputes, visited Delhi in a gesture reflecting warmer bilateral ties. The visit suggests a potential reset in relations between the two countries amid ongoing cooperation discussions.

items.title: Meerut police arrest man for plotting suicide attacks on Army camp
items.feedTitle: Meerut Police arrest 22-year-old man for plotting to carry out suicide attacks on Army camp
items.summary: Meerut police arrested a 22-year-old man, Uzaid, for allegedly plotting suicide attacks targeting an Army camp. Investigators say he was in contact with a Jammu-based resident and both were running an online network backed by Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti.

immigration.title: IBM offers exit packages to H-1B, green card holders by end 2026
immigration.feedTitle: IBM to H-1B visa and green card holders in its biggest division: You can leave the company by end of 2026
immigration.summary: IBM is offering H-1B visa and green card holders in its largest division the option to leave the company by the end of 2026, signaling potential workforce restructuring. The move reflects ongoing uncertainty in the employment immigration landscape under the Trump administration.

immigration.title: DOL proposes sweeping overhaul of PERM labor certification (proposed, not final)
immigration.feedTitle: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
immigration.summary: The U.S. Department of Labor has proposed significant modernization of the PERM (Permanent Employment-Based Immigration) labor certification process, including a new 30-day expedited option alongside traditional lengthy procedures. The proposal aims to strengthen labor market protections while updating requirements that have remained largely unchanged for decades; this is a proposed rule still open for public comment, not yet finalized.

immigration.title: Congressman Ro Khanna flags persistent H-1B visa processing delays
immigration.feedTitle: Ro Khanna urges US State Department to fix H-1B delays
immigration.summary: Congressman Ro Khanna has urged the U.S. State Department to address significant H-1B visa delays that are leaving Indian workers stranded abroad for months. The delays are preventing skilled workers from beginning employment and adding uncertainty to immigration timelines.

items.title: Indian markets rally 1,382 points on FII inflows, cheaper crude
items.feedTitle: Markets rally in early trade on foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil; Sensex jumps 1,382 points
items.summary: The Sensex jumped over 1,380 points in early trade Tuesday as foreign institutional investors resumed buying amid falling crude oil prices and positive global sentiment. The rally across banking and IT stocks pushed Nifty above 25,700 as investors rotated back into equities from defensive positions.

items.title: Tech sell-off resumes as Nvidia euphoria fades amid governance concerns
items.feedTitle: Tech sell-off resumes as euphoria from Jensen Huang’s Nvidia return subsides
items.summary: U.S. stock markets retreated Tuesday as investor enthusiasm over Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia dissipated, with tech stocks leading declines. The sell-off reflects renewed concerns about AI valuations and governance issues at the chip giant, offsetting Monday's 31% surge.

items.title: Oil prices fall as supply glut concerns offset Middle East risks
items.feedTitle: Oil Prices Fall as Supply Glut Concerns Offset Middle East Fears
items.summary: Crude oil prices continued their recent decline as market concerns about global supply abundance outweighed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. The falling energy costs are providing some support to markets and helping offset inflationary pressures.

items.title: Dell beats estimates, guides above views on AI server strength
items.feedTitle: Dell Technologies Smashes Q3 Estimates, Guides Above Views
items.summary: Dell Technologies smashed third-quarter earnings estimates and lifted annual forecasts, crediting surging demand for AI servers. The company authorized a $25 billion share buyback, signaling confidence in business momentum despite broader tech sector volatility.

items.title: Thanksgiving dinner prices hit record high amid food inflation surge
items.feedTitle: Thanksgiving dinner prices hit an all-time high – and one staple is driving the surge
items.summary: Thanksgiving meal costs have reached an all-time high this year, driven by elevated prices for turkey, cranberries, sweet potatoes and other staples. The price surge reflects ongoing food inflation that is straining household budgets across the country.

cards.title: Amor Fati: Embracing What You Cannot Control
cards.insight: The Stoics taught that we cannot control external events—only our judgment and response to them. Kilmar Abrego Garcia's voluntary departure after a 20-month legal battle exemplifies accepting what cannot be forced, redirecting energy toward what remains within one's power: the choice to leave with dignity.
cards.takeaway: Identify one situation frustrating you today. Separate what you control (your effort, attitude, preparation) from what you don't (others' decisions, outcomes). Act fully on the former and release attachment to the latter.

cards.title: Premeditatio Malorum: The Strength in Anticipating Difficulty
cards.insight: Seneca advocated mentally rehearsing challenges to build resilience—not from pessimism, but from clarity. Residents warned about the Iowa detonation who mentally prepare for potential disruption practice this Stoic discipline, reducing panic and enabling wiser choices.
cards.takeaway: Before an uncertain event (the Thanksgiving storm, a difficult conversation), spend five minutes imagining the worst plausible outcome and how you'd respond. This calm rehearsal replaces anxiety with readiness.

cards.title: Memento Mori: Mortality as Moral Compass
cards.insight: The Stoics regularly contemplated mortality not to despair, but to clarify what truly matters. Market volatility and AI hype cycles lose their grip on attention when weighed against the brevity of life—pointing toward more meaningful pursuits.
cards.takeaway: Ask yourself: 'If I had one year left, would I spend it chasing this market gain or this achievement?' Use the answer to audit your current priorities.

cards.title: Virtue as the Only True Good
cards.insight: Marcus Aurelius insisted that virtue—wisdom, courage, justice, discipline—is the only reliable good, since health, wealth and reputation can be lost. Jensen Huang's public acknowledgment of his mistakes and commitment to therapy demonstrates that character repair is possible and more valuable than status recovery.
cards.takeaway: When you stumble, focus on the internal work of understanding and correction over external reputation management. Integrity compounds; image fades.
